# Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Observability Integrations

> Serverless implementation (Spoke) that ships Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP audit, EMS, and FPolicy events to observability vendors, and builds CloudWatch-native monitoring from CloudFormation templates. The "which collection route" decision is made in the Hub (Adoption Playbook — Observability), not here; this repository is where a chosen route is implemented.

## Entry points

- [README](README.md): Repository hub with the task-oriented "Get Started" table.
- [Documentation index (English)](docs/en/README.md): Every document by category, generated from one category map.
- [ドキュメント索引 (Japanese)](docs/ja/README.md): The same index in Japanese, same set of documents.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Conventions, commands, boundaries, and output standards for coding agents.

## Monitoring design hub

- [Monitoring design](docs/en/monitoring-design.md): In-repo implementation index for CloudWatch-native monitoring of FSx for ONTAP, organised as four layers (sizing, metric catalog, alert design, automation); the collection-route choice is deferred to the Hub.
- [Sizing and headroom](docs/en/sizing-and-headroom.md): AWS sizing rules with sources, a placeholder worked example, a derived headroom formula tied to the 6-hour cooldown, and warning/critical/emergency thresholds.
- [Capacity automation](docs/en/capacity-automation.md): Options for acting on SSD capacity alarms (T4 guarded SSD auto-increase sample planned, not implemented; throughput and volume autosize are runbooks), irreversibility and cooldown facts, Terraform ignore_changes, and a verification plan.
- [T4 implementation design](docs/en/capacity-automation-t4-design.md): Planned, not implemented. Guards, ceiling validation against the documented per-file-system SSD maximum, lock states (including the blocked latch and UPDATED_OPTIMIZING as non-terminal), Object Lock decision archive (compliance mode for auto), IAM and test plan for the T4 guarded SSD auto-increase sample.

## CloudWatch templates

- [Performance and capacity dashboard](shared/templates/fsxn-monitoring-dashboard.yaml): CloudFormation dashboard for IOPS, throughput, network, and capacity, with capacity and throughput-utilization alarms.
- [Per-qtree quota monitor](shared/templates/qtree-quota-monitor.yaml): Lambda polls the ONTAP REST API with pagination (up to 10,000 records per SVM), publishes per-qtree quota custom metrics plus an SVM-level maximum that the threshold alarm reads, and supports optional TLS verification (unit-tested against mocked ONTAP responses; live-verified on 2026-10-06 on a first-generation, single-HA-pair file system: 4 consecutive polls published all series with values matching ONTAP, and the alarm went OK → ALARM → OK; second generation, multi-HA-pair, CA-verified TLS, SNS delivery, and pagination beyond one page not yet verified) — see the alarm, coverage, and security notes in monitoring-design.md.
- [Log-based alarm](shared/templates/cloudwatch-log-alarm.yaml): Alarms directly from CloudWatch Logs content using the AWS::CloudWatch::LogAlarm resource.

## Terraform modules

- [Monitoring dashboard module (Terraform)](terraform/fsxn-monitoring-dashboard/README.md): Terraform equivalent of the dashboard template with the capacity and throughput-utilization alarms plus opt-in CPU, disk, and per-volume alarms; provider constraint `>= 6.67.0`; offline-verified with a mock provider, and applied twice to a first-generation, single-HA-pair file system (2026-10-05; and 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-07 (UTC), where the capacity alarm went OK → ALARM → OK on real data); second generation, multi-HA-pair, and SNS delivery not yet verified.
- [Terraform module usage](terraform/fsxn-monitoring-dashboard/README.md#usage): Fetching only the module (git source pinned to the release tag `terraform-fsxn-monitoring-dashboard-v0.1.1` or to a commit, archive URL, or sparse checkout, with measured download sizes), the minimum IAM policy verified on 2026-10-07 (`examples/basic/iam-policy.json`, scoped to resource ARNs by `name_prefix`), init/plan/apply/destroy from `examples/basic/`, and post-apply checks; a [Japanese](terraform/fsxn-monitoring-dashboard/README.ja.md) version has the same structure.
- [ONTAP custom-metrics module (Terraform)](terraform/fsxn-ontap-custom-metrics/README.md): Phase T2. A VPC Lambda polls the ONTAP REST API of one file system and publishes `FSxONTAP/Qtree` (same series as the qtree template, whose inline code is generated from the same source) and `FSxONTAP/SnapMirror` health and lag from the destination file system, with per-collector `CollectorSucceeded` heartbeats and 7 alarms in Terraform state; providers `aws >= 6.67.0` and `archive >= 2.8.1`; implemented and offline-verified (unit tests, `make terraform`), live verification pending (`unverified`); tag `terraform-fsxn-ontap-custom-metrics-v0.1.0` not yet created.
- [ONTAP custom-metrics module usage](terraform/fsxn-ontap-custom-metrics/README.md#usage): ONTAP user with the `fsxadmin-readonly` role, Secrets Manager secret ARN input, network options (NAT gateway, module-created `monitoring`/`secretsmanager` interface endpoints, or existing ones, with the endpoint conflict note), estimated deployer IAM policy (`examples/basic/iam-policy.json`, not run with a limited role), deploy/verify/destroy, and the cross-file-system SnapMirror note; a [Japanese](terraform/fsxn-ontap-custom-metrics/README.ja.md) version has the same structure.
- [Log alarm module (Terraform)](terraform/fsxn-log-alarm/README.md): Phase T3, the equivalent of the log-alarm template. Because the pinned `hashicorp/aws` 6.67.0 has no native LogAlarm resource, it uses one `aws_cloudwatch_log_metric_filter` plus one `aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm` per detection on a log group that receives the file system's EMS and audit events. A data-driven `detections` map ships five recipes, including `wafl.vol.autoSize.fail`, plus failed-access, bulk-delete, privileged-operations, and unauthorized-access, and callers can override or extend it; provider `aws >= 6.67.0`; implemented and offline-verified (`terraform test`, `make terraform`), live verification pending (`unverified`); tag `terraform-fsxn-log-alarm-v0.1.0` not yet created.
- [Log alarm module usage](terraform/fsxn-log-alarm/README.md#usage): The CloudWatch Logs log group prerequisite and its syslog VPC endpoint delivery path, estimated deployer IAM policy (`examples/basic/iam-policy.json`, not run with a limited role), deploy/verify/destroy, the detection-recipe table, and the symmetric metric-filter-versus-LogAlarm trade-off with a how-to-choose note; a [Japanese](terraform/fsxn-log-alarm/README.ja.md) version has the same structure.

## Forwarding routes

- [Audit log setup](docs/en/ontap-audit-setup.md): Enabling FSx for ONTAP file-access audit logging and the source paths it writes.
- [EMS detection capabilities](docs/en/ems-detection-capabilities.md): The EMS event catalog and how EMS webhook events are forwarded.
- [FPolicy operational guide](docs/en/fpolicy-operational-guide.md): Running the FPolicy server and forwarding real-time file-operation events.

## Verification results

- [CloudWatch monitoring verification](docs/en/verification-results-cloudwatch-monitoring.md): 2026-10-05 live run of the dashboard template and the Terraform module, and two 2026-10-06 qtree quota monitor runs (the first stopped after one successful poll; the re-run completed 4 polls and the alarm's OK → ALARM → OK path), and a 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-07 (UTC) capacity alarm real-data run of both the template and the module (OK → ALARM → OK), all on a first-generation, single-HA-pair file system; alarm transitions, findings, and what remains unverified (second generation, multi-HA-pair, SNS delivery, CA-verified TLS, qtree pagination beyond one page).
- [FPolicy, S3 Access Points, and session verification](docs/en/verification-results-fpolicy-s3ap-and-session.md): E2E results for FPolicy forwarding, FSx for ONTAP S3 Access Points, and session handling.
- [EMS and FPolicy verification](docs/en/verification-results-ems-fpolicy.md): E2E results for the EMS webhook and FPolicy event paths.
- [Datadog verification](docs/en/verification-results-datadog.md): E2E delivery results for the Datadog integration.
- [Splunk verification](docs/en/verification-results-splunk.md): E2E delivery results for the Splunk integration.
- [Grafana verification](docs/en/verification-results-grafana.md): E2E delivery results for the Grafana integration.
- [New Relic verification](docs/en/verification-results-new-relic.md): E2E delivery results for the New Relic integration.
- [Elastic verification](docs/en/verification-results-elastic.md): E2E delivery results for the Elastic integration.
- [Dynatrace verification](docs/en/verification-results-dynatrace.md): E2E delivery results for the Dynatrace integration.
- [Sumo Logic verification](docs/en/verification-results-sumo-logic.md): E2E delivery results for the Sumo Logic integration.
- [Honeycomb verification](docs/en/verification-results-honeycomb.md): E2E delivery results for the Honeycomb integration.
- [OpenTelemetry Collector verification](docs/en/verification-results-otel-collector.md): E2E delivery results for the OTel Collector path.
